text:
alex: Quick async — what I did / blockers / today:
alex: - Deployed routing split for /api/v2 to route by model header; canary at 15%
alex: - Tuned batching to hit p95 latency targets
alex: Blocker: intermittent 429s coming from the proxy when request token count > ~2000, only observed on the canary pool
alex: Today: will rollback canary to 5%, add prefix caching, and open PR to add per-route rate hints to auth middleware. pinging @priya for rate-policy review.

priya: I see the 429 spike in the dashboard — thinburst pattern from a handful of clients.
priya: can you paste the canary config + rate-policy snippet?

alex: config snippet below:
```yaml
canary:
  percent: 15
  pool: p-canary-raw
  routing:
    header: "x-model"
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  target_latency_ms: 120
rate_policy:
  - route: /api/v2
    token_limit_per_min: 10000
```

mateo: my hunch — with 4k batch token cap the runtime opens bigger KV caches and trips longer kernel paths, which under contention can lead to 429s. try lowering max_batch_tokens to 2048 or cap canary concurrency.

jen: also check auth latency curves. if JWT validation spikes, requests pile up and you see downstream 429s.
jen: @deploy-bot did the jwt-rotate job run around the spike?

deploy-bot: Automated deploy: routing-canary v2.1 -> p-canary-raw (started 6902467920) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Cron job jwt-rotate started 6902467600; completed 6902467665.

alex: thanks — jwt-rotate timing matches a small auth latency bump at ~6902467700 and a concurrent retry burst.
alex: Plan: roll canary to 5%, lower max_batch_tokens to 2048, add a temporary per-route limit for the canary (e.g. 6 rps), and run a lightweight trace. I'll open the PR now.

sam: I can help with traces and flame graphs, also can run a synthetic load to reproduce the thinburst.
sam: if you want, I can reduce the canary percent while you prep the PR.

priya: ack, I'll prioritize reviewing the rate-policy PR when it's up. long-term idea: adaptive batching that considers inflight concurrency per pool.

mateo: +1 for adaptive batching. also recommend per-pool KV cache size limits to avoid eviction thrash.

jen: filing infra follow-up to document jwt-rotate impact on auth latency and add a quick runbook.

alex: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/2789 — please drop comments. rolling canary down now, will post updates in this thread. :thumbsup: 

sam: :thumbsup:

alex: Update: rolled canary to 5% and pushed batch config change to canary pool (max_batch_tokens=2048). Monitoring traces now, p95 latency dropping. Will follow up if anything else shows up.
